article.story: STILLWATER, Okla. -- — Luka Bogavac scored 14 points, and Jordan Burks and Parker Robinson added 11 each and Oklahoma State opened its season with a 91-60 win over Incarnate Word on Monday. The Cowboys scored the first 12 points and forced six turnovers before the Cardinals got on the board. Jacob Walker had two steals during the opening surge and assisted on Burks’ dunk that made it 12-0 with 16:39 left in the first half. Oklahoma State continued to pull away and led 54-17 at halftime. The Cowboys closed the half on an 11-0 run, capped by Bogavac’s 3-pointer at the buzzer. Walker finished with eight assists and four steals as Oklahoma State forced 21 turnovers and committed only nine. Mekhi Conner led Incarnate Word with 18 points, and Godswill Erheriene added 12. Oklahoma State shot 45% from the field and finished with 15 offensive rebounds. Up next Oklahoma State: Hosts Queens on Friday. Incarnate Word: Versus Chicago State this Thursday. ------ Sign up for Top 25 poll alerts here, visit the Top 25 here and see AP’s full men’s basketball coverage here
